metadata.description: Agent skills for building data pipelines with Estuary

plugins.name: estuary-captures
plugins.description: Capture skills for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, HubSpot, HTTP webhooks, and 148+ other connectors

plugins.name: estuary-materializations
plugins.description: Materialization skills for PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, ClickHouse, and any destination connector

plugins.name: estuary-derivations
plugins.description: Derivation skills for transforming Estuary collections in SQL, TypeScript, or Python: filters, aggregations, joins, array flattening, stateful logic, and time windowing

plugins.name: estuary-operations
plugins.description: Operational skills for flowctl setup, task health monitoring, log analysis, connector management, and SSH tunnel troubleshooting

plugins.name: estuary-schema
plugins.description: Schema modification skills for Estuary collections and materializations: projections, field selection, custom column types, redaction, null defaults, and defining fields
